_readme: One entry per real trek, event or challenge. Run:
and each entry becomes site/activity-<id>.html with its own gallery.
Optional:  tagline, category, date, location, summary, body,
category must match a folder name under site/images/gallery/ —
that is where the page's photo gallery comes from.
Only fill in what actually happened. A missing field is omitted
from the page; an invented one is worse than a blank.
The entry below is a worked example. Replace it with a real trek
or delete it — the array can be empty and nothing breaks.
_example is ignored by the builder; rename it to activities[0] to use it.
